verdict.rationale: GitLab is itself a CI/CD platform with native pipelines, and it documents headless automation through its REST API ('Automate your workflows'), token or OAuth authentication, an autogenerated OpenAPI spec, and an official CLI. Agent flows can also be configured with triggers, so they run without an interactive UI. Missing for 10: explicit docs showing the GitLab CLI or Duo agents running non-interactively inside a CI job, details of the CLI's headless/scripting mode, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless agent automation.
